resources.string: Recommended on SM8650. Runs on the NPU: fast and the most power efficient. Chinese / English / Cantonese / Japanese / Korean, punctuation included.
Recommended on SM8550. Runs on the NPU: fast and the most power efficient. Chinese / English / Cantonese / Japanese / Korean, punctuation included.
Same model on the CPU, works on any phone. Also the automatic fallback when the NPU fails.
